title: Nine Pounds of Flour
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：bread　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bread 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to bake ① bread she could not cut, and she said the cutting was the whole of the lesson. The ② bread, meaning the loaf and not the flour, was nine pounds and was carried by whoever came last; bread, she said, is the only thing in a kitchen that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ bread on that shelf had the same crust, and the ④ bread at the front, meaning the one the baker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly. Bread, my grandmother said, is nine parts flour and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the flour is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ bread was the whole of the winter, meaning the living it carried and not the loaf. The ⑥ bread, meaning the living and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody shares and nobody questions; bread, he said, is either something you bake or the only word that means both a loaf and a living. She said the living is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ bread had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the flour. The ⑧ bread of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pounds of flour and eleven years of baking; bread, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ bread I remember is the one at the front, which was broken in 1969 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ loaf of bread, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being broken; every bread, she said, is a living that has agreed to look like a loaf. She said the living was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 面包（指那条面包本身，与面粉相对）
C. 固定搭配：bake bread 烤面包
D. n. 面包（指架子上每一条）
E. n. 面包（指前面那一条）
F. n. 生计；口粮（抽象：与那条面包相对）
G. n. 那份生计（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The bread, meaning the loaf and not the flour
bread was the whole of the winter
the bread had become a photograph in a report
The bread of the whole thing
A loaf of bread, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: bake bread 意为“烤面包”，1946 年母亲被派去烤她切不动的面包。
bread 意为“面包”，指那条面包本身而不是面粉，重九磅，由最后走的人拿走。
bread 指架子上每一条面包，每一条都是同样的硬壳。
bread 指前面那一条（面包师留的那一条），是唯一有人认真称过的。
bread 意为“生计、口粮”，与那条面包相对，父亲说 bread 就是那个冬天的全部。
bread 为抽象用法，指那份生计本身，是屋子里人人都分、却没人质疑的东西。
bread 意为“面包”，到 1964 年这条 bread 成了报告里的一张照片。
bread 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九磅面粉和十一年的烘烤。
bread 意为“面包”，我记得的是前面那一条，1969 年被掰开，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
bread 为抽象总称，祖母说一条面包是唯一会因为被掰开分食而变好的东西。

answers: In 1946 my mother was sent to bake bread she could not cut, and she said the cutting was the whole of the lesson.
The bread, meaning the loaf and not the flour, was nine pounds and was carried by whoever came last.
Every bread on that shelf had the same crust.
The bread at the front, meaning the one the baker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever weighed properly.
My father said bread was the whole of the winter, meaning the living it carried and not the loaf.
A loaf of bread, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being broken.
